source: Matchups, kickoffs, venues and roofs for all 18 weeks from nflverse (§4.3). Week 1 was cross-checked game by game against ESPN: both agree on every matchup and every kickoff time. Bye weeks implied by this schedule match byes.json for all 32 teams.
note: Lines, weather, scores and leaders are intentionally absent, not lost. An unauthored field is omitted rather than zeroed, so the page can tell "nothing posted yet" from "posted as zero". Implied team totals are authored alongside the lines they come from; a component must not compute them (§11). Roofs follow nflverse except where it is plainly wrong: it defaults open-air international grounds to dome, so Melbourne, the Maracanã, Stade de France, Munich and Estadio Banorte are corrected to outdoor and the Bernabéu to retractable. Weather short-circuits on roof, so calling an open cricket ground a dome would suppress a forecast that matters. Blank nflverse roofs are retractables, where opening is a game-day decision.
